summary.intent: Plan and execute phase 49 (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation unwrap consolidation), then run full PR-QA (simplify, security reviews, CodeRabbit CLI) before pushing and creating a PR.
summary.outcome: Phase 49 fully planned (5 plans, 3 waves, 6 requirements including a mid-session scope expansion to batch+drag move parity), executed (all plans complete, all gates green), simplified (code quality + correctness fixes applied), and security reviewed (LOW risk overall, one MEDIUM folderKey-zeroing issue found and fixed). Branch is ready for push and PR creation but the transcript ends before that step.

repo: reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange (reencrypt.ts:49) is fully key-agnostic (takes raw source/dest/ipns key bytes) — reusable verbatim for the shared-folder move case without owner vs. recipient distinction
share_keys entries are keyed by itemId (file UUID), not parent folder — file keys do NOT need re-registration after a folder move; download path resolves by itemId only
adoptSharedFolderResult must only be called for the source result after a move, not the dest — calling it for dest would corrupt the sharedFolderTree projection (which filters by shareId only)

File IPNS key for re-encryption must come from share_keys keyType:'file-ipns', NOT FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted (owner-wrapped; recipient cannot decrypt it) — same pattern as updateSharedFileHandler
SharedFolderClient Pick allowlist (shared-folder-projection.ts:28-38) must be updated to include new methods; it only listed the 7 Phase 48 methods
SDK dist/ is gitignored — CI rebuilds it; never commit dist/ changes

Web tsc -b checks the built SDK dist, not source — after adding new SDK methods, rebuilding dist is required before web typecheck (though index.d.ts is a barrel re-export pointing to client.d.ts, so the methods are visible via that chain)

Batch move in the private vault is a web-layer loop pattern (useFileBrowserActions → handleBatchMoveConfirm → useFolderMutations.handleMoveItems looping single-item moves) — no dedicated SDK batch method; private MoveDialog already supports an items prop
useSharedNavigation.ts appeared in the phase 49 diff but was not listed in any plan's files_modified — needs investigation before PR

code.finding: enumerateSharedSubtree's DFS did not zero per-iteration folderKey after use, leaving plaintext AES folder keys live in heap across the full traversal — fixed with try/finally zeroing after each unwrap
Pick allowlist for SharedFolderClient only covered Phase 48 methods; any new Phase 49 methods (moveInSharedFolder, enumerateSharedSubtree) must be explicitly added here
sdkCore.moveItem throws 'An item with this name already exists in destination' on collision — no auto-rename needed, propagates through runWrite → p.setError
runWrite swallowed errors and returned void, causing batchMoveItemsHandler to always clearSelection even on failure — fixed by making runWrite return a boolean and gating clearSelection on success
Test used field-access not strict-shape equality, so adding parentId to enumerated nodes was non-breaking and the existing tests needed only additive assertions

workflow: Sequential wave execution (no worktrees) chosen for autonomous/AFK runs — parallel-worktree merge-back protocol requires interactive merge-base handling that is error-prone to drive unattended
GSD plan-checker caught a real gap (REQ-3 had no web unit test, so its verify step passed vacuously) in addition to doc-formatting nits — worth running even when the plan looks clean
CodeRabbit CLI review runs before PR creation; after PR is created, CodeRabbit auto-posts a GitHub review that should be addressed with /resolve-pr-reviews
Intel API surface (regex extractor) was empty — RESEARCH.md carries all verified symbol refs and is the more reliable source for the planner
Prettier reformats on commit can invalidate a planned edit — always re-read the file after a commit that touches it before making further edits
For scope expansions mid-planning, update both ROADMAP.md and CONTEXT.md before spawning the planner to avoid contradictions between the two

friction: Git commit signing (1Password) wedges during unattended AFK runs — had to disable repo-local signing with git config --local commit.gpgsign false; requires manual re-enable and a signed rebase before merge because the repo enforces signed commits on PRs
Prettier reformatted client.ts during a commit, breaking the immediately-planned security fix edit — required re-reading the file before proceeding
GSD plan-checker required a full revision round (blocker on missing REQ-3 web unit test + two RESEARCH.md doc nits), adding latency before execution could start
Intel API surface regeneration produced an empty output (regex extractor unpopulated), making the step a no-op
Web tsc -b staleness concern with new SDK methods required investigation of dist type declaration structure before confirming wave 2 could proceed safely
open_items: PR still needs to be pushed to remote and created; CodeRabbit GitHub review then needs to be addressed with /resolve-pr-reviews
repo-local commit.gpgsign=false must be re-enabled (git config --local --unset commit.gpgsign) and branch needs a signed rebase before merge
useSharedNavigation.ts appears in the phase 49 diff but was not listed in any plan's files_modified — investigate whether this is intentional wiring or an unplanned side-effect
REQ-5 e2e tests (two-account within-share move + decrypt-survival) require live docker stack for actual execution — deferred UAT, gated on main push
Deferred: extract useMultiSelect hook shared between private and shared file browsers (cross-boundary scope creep beyond phase 49)
Deferred: batch key-refetch optimization in batchMoveItemsHandler (currently re-fetches share_keys once per file; parity-acceptable for v1)
Deferred: concurrent DFS in enumerateSharedSubtree (sequential by design to avoid gateway rate-limiting, but noted as a follow-up)
